EC1: Prior systemic therapy targeting PD-1: PD-L1 axis.
EC2: Patients who are curable [AND] by conventional multidisciplinary management.
EC3: Patients with severe [OR] and/or uncontrolled concurrent medical disease that in the opinion of the investigator could cause unacceptable safety risks or compromise compliance with the protocol.
EC4: Patients who have received wide field radiotherapy  ≤ 4 weeks [OR] or limited field radiation for palliation  < 2 weeks prior to screening [OR] or who have [NOT] not recovered [AND] adequately from side effects of such therapy [AND].
EC5: Patients who have active infections requiring therapy [AND].
EC6: Patients that are known to be positive for Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) [OR] (HIV 1/2 antibodies), active Hepatitis B [OR] (HBsAg reactive), or Hepatitis C [AND] (HCV RNA [qualitative] is detected); patients with negative Hepatitis C antibody testing may not need RNA testing.
EC7: Patients that have a known psychiatric [OR] or substance abuse disorder that would interfere with cooperation with the requirements of the trial.
EC8: Patients who received systemic anti-cancer treatment prior to the first dose of study drug within the following time frames:
EC9: Patients with active autoimmune disease [OR] or a documented history of [AND]  autoimmune disease [OR] or syndrome that requires  systemic steroids [OR] or immunosuppressive agents. Patients with vitiligo [OR] or resolved childhood asthma [OR]/atopy would be exception to this rule. Patients that require inhaled steroids or local steroid injections would not be excluded from the study. Patients with hypothyroidism [AND] [NOT] not from autoimmune disease that is stable on hormone replacement [AND] will not be excluded from the study.
EC10: Women who are pregnant [OR] or nursing [OR]/breastfeeding.
EC11: Known hypersensitivity [AND] to pembrolizumab [OR]  or another mAb.
EC12: Has a history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis [AND]  that required steroids [OR] or current pneumonitis.
EC13: Patients with untreated central nervous system disease. Patients with controlled treated CNS lesions who have undergone surgery [OR] or stereotactic radiosurgery and stable for 4 weeks are eligible.
EC14: Inability to comply with protocol required procedures.
EC15: Patients with medical conditions that require chronic systemic corticosteroid therapy [OR] or require [AND] any other form of immunosuppressive medication. However, patients using physiologic replacement doses of hydrocortisone, or its equivalent, will be considered eligible for this study: up to 20 mg hydrocortisone ([OR]or 5 mg of prednisone) in the morning and 10 mg hydrocortisone  ([OR] or 2.5 mg prednisone) in the evening.
EC16: Patients with the risk factors [AND] for bowel obstruction [OR] or bowel perforation (examples include but not limited to a history of acute diverticulitis [OR], intra-abdominal abscess [OR], abdominal carcinomatosis).
EC17: Patients who have received a live vaccine within 30 days prior to the first dose of trial treatment.
